snippet.title: Game Gear : Royal Stone - Hirakareshi Toki no Tobira (JPN)
snippet.description:
Royal Stone - Hirakareshi Toki no Tobira (ロイアル・ストーン ～開かれし時の扉) is an RPG that developed and published by Sega back in 1995, exclusively for the Sega Game Gear handheld system and the Japanese market.

The story focuses on a female knight named Eva, who is accused of betraying her father and kingdom of Martalia and banished. Now, she’s out to clear her name and stop the true threat to the kingdom. 

Royal Stone is a turn based, tactical RPG where you explore dungeons, gather information, cast magic, and recruit monsters. There is an "elemental" system consisting of fire, wind, water, and earth to determine strengths and weaknesses. 
In general, it's quite impressive for it's time and defintely worths a try.

The game was later re-released as one of the four games pre-installed on the black model Game Gear Micro.

It's not an import friendly experience but since 2013 there is an English translation patch. You can find it here : 
https://www.romhacking.net/translations/2076/
